headline.purpose: Page titles, dashboard greeting, request titles (24px, 28px from 640px).

title.purpose: Panel header titles; dialog titles step up to 18px.

body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, list rows; inputs use 15px below 640px.

body-sm.purpose: Panel descriptions, meta lines, hints and errors.

button.purpose: Button text; brand, approve and danger variants use weight 600.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase request-form section headings with brass 'Section n' prefix.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels, legends and board month labels.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, KPI labels, table header text; tabular.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting: panels, inputs, outline and filled buttons.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Floating: menus, tooltips, board-unit hover, skip link.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Modal: dialogs and the navigation sheet.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible; inputs use a focus border plus 3px ring at 20%. Inside the navy shell the ring is brass.

shadows.name: awaiting-ring
shadows.purpose: 2px brass ring offset 2px marking board units waiting for the viewer.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The world's single easing for entrances and pulses.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Fade up 6px: page headers, form sections, menus, dialogs, tooltips.

motion.name: tile
motion.purpose: Board units: fade, scale from 0.86, de-blur 2px; staggered 60ms per row + 14ms per unit, capped at 700ms.

motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.purpose: Amber halo on the current progress-tracker station.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Colour/shadow/transform state changes; buttons press 1px on :active, units lift 2px on hover.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 24px, inputs drop to 14px, tables replace stacked cards, board tallies appear, tracker turns horizontal.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Fixed 256px sidebar replaces the 56px mobile header; gutter 40px; KPI strip goes 4-across.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Main column + 380px right rail (300px on Reports); main max-width 1280px.

components.css: .ds-board{display:grid;gap:6px;width:340px;padding:16px;background:var(--surface);font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;} .ds-month{width:44px;flex-shrink:0;align-self:center;text-align:right;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.08em;color:var(--muted);} .ds-units{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(52px,1fr));gap:6px;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 8px;list-style:none;border-left:1px solid var(--line);} .ds-unit{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:5/4;border-radius:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.025em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-decoration:none;transition:opacity 200ms,transform 200ms,box-shadow 200ms;animation:ds-tile 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;} .ds-unit:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);} .ds-unit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;} .ds-unit--approved{background:var(--st-approved);color:#fff;} .ds-unit--pending{background:var(--st-pending);color:oklch(0.3 0.06 70);} .ds-unit--returned{background:var(--st-returned);color:#fff;} .ds-unit--cancelled{background-color:var(--st-cancelled-soft);color:var(--st-cancelled-text);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch,var(--st-cancelled) 40%,transparent);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 5px,color-mix(in oklch,var(--st-cancelled) 22%,transparent) 5px 6px);} .ds-unit--draft{background:var(--st-draft);color:var(--st-draft-text);} .ds-unit--awaiting{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--surface),0 0 0 4px var(--brand);} @keyframes ds-tile{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.86);filter:blur(2px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-unit{animation-duration:1ms;transition-duration:1ms;}}

components.css: .ds-track{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,140px);margin:0;padding:16px;list-style:none;background:var(--surface);font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink);} .ds-track li{position:relative;display:grid;gap:4px;padding-right:12px;font-size:14px;} .ds-track li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:28px;top:13px;height:3px;width:calc(100% - 28px);border-radius:9999px;background:var(--line);} .ds-track li.is-done::after{background:var(--st-approved);} .ds-track b{font-weight:500;} .ds-track small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-track .ds-wait{color:var(--st-pending-text);font-weight:500;} .ds-stn{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:9999px;border:3px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--surface);box-sizing:border-box;} .ds-stn svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke-width:3;} .is-done .ds-stn{border-color:var(--st-approved);background:var(--st-approved);color:#fff;} .is-current .ds-stn{border-color:var(--st-pending);background:var(--st-pending-soft);animation:ds-pulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite;} .is-current .ds-stn i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--st-pending);} .ds-track li:not(.is-done):not(.is-current) b{color:var(--muted);} @keyframes ds-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklch,var(--st-pending) 55%,transparent);}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px color-mix(in oklch,var(--st-pending) 0%,transparent);}}

narrative.overview:
The app reads like the availability chart on the wall of a property sales gallery. The visitor takes in the whole year's requests at a glance and can see what is settled, what is on hold and what was turned back before reading any words. A deep ink-navy shell holds the navigation the way a gallery's dark joinery frames the board. Crisp white work cards sit on a cool, faintly blue-tinted ground. A single brass accent marks what to act on, and a fixed five-colour status vocabulary (approved green, pending amber, returned coral, cancelled slate, draft grey) carries meaning on every screen.

The density is that of a working tool. Panels are flat, sit on a 1px hairline and a whisper of shadow, and carry quiet sentence-case titles. Numbers always use tabular figures. Small, tracked, uppercase labels set in Geist name the fields the way a placard names a unit, and they echo the paper form WCT-F-4.18-2 that the system replaces. The world deliberately rejects the grey SaaS sidebar with one blue accent: the shell is navy, the accent is brass, and colour is spent on status, not decoration.

The brass is a placeholder. WCT will supply its official corporate colours and logo later, so every brand use goes through the swappable `--brand-*` tokens, and the "WCT" wordmark tile is a stand-in component. The printable PDF is a separate case: it reproduces the paper form's slate-and-Helvetica look (form evidence) rather than the app's world.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-navy shell (sidebar, mobile header, tooltips, overlays) around white work panels on a cool ground.
One swappable brass accent for "act here": primary action, awaiting counts, the approvals badge, rings on units waiting for you.
A reserved status vocabulary of five tones, used as dots, badges, board tiles and tracker stations, and never for anything else.
Geist Sans with tabular numerals throughout; 11px uppercase tracked placard labels.
The month-row availability board is the signature element, and the transit-line progress tracker is its companion on detail pages.
Full light and dark themes driven by the same token names.

rules.name: The Reserved Status Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, coral, slate and grey mean approved, pending, returned, cancelled and draft. They are never used as chart series, decoration, brand or category colour, and a status is never shown in any other colour.

rules.name: The Swappable Brass Rule
rules.body: Brand colour enters only through `--brand-*` tokens. Never write a literal brass value, never invent a WCT logo, and treat the "WCT" tile in the wordmark as a placeholder component.

rules.name: The Brass Means Act Rule
rules.body: Brass marks where the viewer should act or what is waiting for them. Approving itself is green, rejecting is coral, and navigation chrome stays navy.

rules.name: The Placard Label Rule
rules.body: A field is named in 11px semibold uppercase with 0.08em tracking, like a gallery placard. The style labels a control, a legend or a board row. It never floats above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every reference number, fee, count, date and time uses `tabular-nums` (tables get it automatically), so columns of figures line up like a price list.

rules.name: The Placard, Not Pedestal Rule
rules.body: Cards rest on a hairline, not on a shadow. If something needs more than the resting shadow, it must be floating above the page (a menu, tooltip or dialog), not just important.

dos: Do reach every colour through its token name (`brand`, `shell`, `st-pending-soft`, and so on) so the light/dark themes and the future WCT palette swap stay one-line changes.
Do show status with the full trio for the tone: a solid dot or tile, the soft wash for badges and banners, and the text tone for words.
Do label form fields with the Placard Label (11px, 600, uppercase, 0.08em, Ink Two) and keep the paper form's vocabulary ("Proposed Candidates", "Conducted By", "Fees (MYR)").
Do set every number in tabular figures, and format money as "RM 31,420.00" and dates as dd/MM/yyyy.
Do keep one brass "New training request" action per screen, top right on desktop and an icon button in the mobile header.
Do keep tap targets at 40px or more (44px for the primary action on phones) and use 15px input text below 640px.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Animation already collapses to 1ms globally, and new motion must use the same `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` ease.
Do use `series-1/2/3` for charts and keep chart gridlines on the `grid` token.
donts: Don't use green, amber, coral, slate or draft grey for anything except request status, including chart series, category tags and decoration.
Don't hard-code a brass or gold value, design a WCT logo, or replace the placeholder wordmark with anything but the official asset.
Don't turn the shell into a grey sidebar with a blue accent. The shell is ink-navy, and blue appears only as the focus ring.
Don't put white text on brass or amber fills. Use Brass Ink on brass and the dark amber-brown on pending units.
Don't nest panels or add shadows beyond the resting shadow to in-page cards.
Don't put a small uppercase label or kicker above a heading. The placard style names fields, legends and board rows only.
Don't use Danger Red for a returned request. Returned is coral; danger is for errors and destructive actions.
